templates.title: Scores vs outcome (standard)
templates.when_used: The author argues the scores do not support the rejection, and the chair declines.
templates.body:
We understand that this outcome may be disappointing. To clarify how decisions are reached:

(1) Final decisions are not determined solely by the reviewer scores that are visible to you. Additional input from senior members of the program committee is also considered, and all factors are carefully weighed.
(2) We understand that not having a chance for rebuttal is frustrating, but this is how the two-phase process works.
(3) The decision is final.

We hope the feedback will be useful in further strengthening your work and helping you secure publication in another leading venue or future AAAI edition.

templates.title: Reviewer misunderstanding (standard)
templates.when_used: The author argues a reviewer misread, misunderstood or did not read the paper, and the chair declines.
templates.body:
We understand that this outcome may be disappointing. Regarding your concerns about the reviews:

(1) Decisions are not based on any single review; all assessments are weighed together.
(2) The review process runs on a very tight schedule, and papers not advanced to Phase 2 do not have an author response period.
(3) Thank you for sharing your view of the review. We will consider your input when studying possible changes for future editions.
(4) The decision is final.

We hope the feedback will be useful in further strengthening your work and helping you secure publication in another leading venue or future AAAI edition.

templates.title: AI-generated review claim (standard)
templates.when_used: The author claims a review was written by an LLM or other AI tool.
templates.body:
Thank you for providing your point of view. Regarding your concern about AI-generated reviews:

(1) The review process includes one review that is clearly identified as AI-generated. It carries no ratings and plays no part in the decision.
(2) If you believe a review violates the reviewing policies or ethical guidelines, you can report it through the form at [ETHICS FORM ADDRESS].
(3) The decision is final.

We hope the feedback will be useful in further strengthening your work and helping you secure publication in another leading venue or future AAAI edition.

templates.title: Wrong-paper review (investigate)
templates.when_used: The author claims a review discusses a different paper than theirs.
templates.body: Thank you for flagging this. We will investigate and follow up with you.

templates.title: Scores vs outcome (forward)
templates.when_used: The author argues the scores do not support the rejection, and the chair decides to look into it.
templates.body: Thank you for flagging your concern about the consistency of the outcome. We will investigate and follow up with you.

templates.title: General dissatisfaction (reconsideration request)
templates.when_used: The author objects to the review or decision without a specific ground and asks for reconsideration.
templates.body: I'm afraid that the decision is final, so we have to decline your request. We understand that not having a chance for rebuttal is frustrating, but this is how the two-phase process works.

templates.title: Other ground (chair writes the reply)
templates.when_used: The author appeals on a ground no other template covers, so the chair writes the reply.

templates.title: Reciprocal-review desk rejection
templates.when_used: The paper was desk-rejected because its nominated reciprocal reviewer did not complete their review.
templates.body:
We understand that this situation is disappointing, and we appreciate the effort you invested in preparing your submission. We would like to clarify the circumstances:

(1) Reciprocal reviewers were informed that failure to complete their assigned reviews could result in desk rejection of the paper(s) that nominated them.
(2) We expected authors to coordinate with their co-authors on reciprocal reviewing responsibilities, so first authors were not warned separately when a nominee had not completed their review.
(3) In your case, the nominated reciprocal reviewer did not complete their assigned review. The desk rejection is therefore consistent with the stated policy.
(4) Please consider the desk rejection final.
